law: ProjectCentral/docs/4-development/world-shell/LEGACY-CRADLE-RETIREMENT.md §3 gate 4 (every owner operation served by the candidate kernel at parity; the 8787 seam retires with a named replacement for each caller) and §5 step 5 (retire the seam once the census shows zero remaining callers).
seam: owner service 8787. In-tree it is the axum server in packages/live-shell (default bind 127.0.0.1:8787, LIVE_SHELL_BIND). Its routes are the Live Set document and device-parameter domain. It serves no ground, day/now, or event route.
method: tests/conformance/owner-service-census.test.mjs parses the server route table and bind port from source, then scans desktop/cradle, packages, cli and scripts for /api/<route> URL literals (after a quote, backtick or template brace) and :8787 literals. Non-comment hits in shipping trees are callers. Hits under tests, docs and derived output are listed separately. A caller is counted per (file, route).

callers.scope: browser or dev-server fallback. The native host branch on line 129 calls tauri live_shell_config.
callers.operation: GET /api/config: default_set, saved_works, kernel_bridge, product_ids, world_scope, current_world, world_error
callers.purpose: Read the shell's host configuration before any owner read.
callers.residual_op_needed: ShellConfigRead for default_set, saved_works, kernel_bridge and the /api/config response shape. CompositionRead (kernel/src/composition.rs) covers only the current_world and product census, in its own shape.
callers.conversion: not converted. The residual fields have no KernelOp, and a conversion would drop default_set and change the result shape that application.ts consumes.

callers.scope: browser or dev-server fallback. A kernel transport (tauri or the dev walk bridge) is used when one exists; the native host branch on line 177 (tauri live_shell_read kind=set) runs only without one; the 8787 fetch is the plain dev-browser fallback.
callers.operation: GET /api/set?path=: {summary, document, revision} for one .als set
callers.purpose: Read one Live Set document for the shell's set reader.
callers.owner: packages/live-set (api::set_json, the contract shared with the kernel)
callers.conversion: converted: readSet calls kernelOp(detectTransport(), live_set_read) when a kernel transport exists. The reading shape is unchanged: {summary, document, revision}.

callers.scope: device panels, registered in panels/index.ts. A kernel transport (tauri or the dev walk bridge) is used when one exists; the 8787 fetch is the plain dev-browser fallback. Before this op the native host had no route for it (source reading: the Tauri origin and the oi-material protocol both refuse /api).
callers.purpose: Parameter tables for the device panels, fetched once per page load.
callers.conversion: converted: deviceDescriptors calls kernelOp(detectTransport(), live_device_descriptors) when a kernel transport exists. The result map is unchanged.

callers.scope: device panels, registered in panels/index.ts. A kernel transport is used when one exists; the 8787 fetch is the plain dev-browser fallback.
callers.operation: GET /api/document/device-params?path&track&device: stored values of one device
callers.purpose: Load the stored parameter values of one device on one track.
callers.conversion: converted: fetchDeviceParams calls kernelOp(detectTransport(), live_device_params_read) when a kernel transport exists. The result map is unchanged.

callers.scope: device panels, registered in panels/index.ts. Method POST. A kernel transport is used when one exists; the 8787 fetch is the plain dev-browser fallback.
callers.operation: POST /api/document/device-param: validate one stored value and write the set back
callers.purpose: Persist one device parameter edit to the Live Set document.
callers.native_path: desktop/cradle/src-tauri/src/main.rs kernel_op (prepared write outside the kernel lock, kernel/src/owner_read.rs, serialised by live_set_owner WRITE_GATE)
callers.conversion: converted: postDeviceParam calls kernelOp(detectTransport(), live_device_param_write) when a kernel transport exists. Refusals name the law as before, through the kernel's error.

callers.scope: the seam's own dev page, served at GET / by the seam server (include_str in main.rs). Not loaded by the native host.
callers.purpose: Developer inspector of one Live Set document.
callers.conversion: not converted. Dev inspector only; it retires with the seam.

dev_transports.note: Dev-only proxy. The comment on line 4 says the axum server on :8787, but the code proxies to 8788 unless VITE_LIVE_SHELL_API is set. Retires with the seam. Its routes are the callers above.

shipping_comment_references: packages/live-dynamics/src/params.rs (doc comment naming /api/device-descriptors; not a caller)

non_seam_relative_api_in_shipping_trees.note: Relative /api routes that are not on the seam's route table. Their server is not in this tree, so the census cannot confirm which process answers them. Recorded so the owner can see the gap.

informational.derived_output: Build output (dist/, build/, ui-dist/) in a scanned tree is rebuilt, never tracked: the census fails on a tracked one and lists untracked output only under CENSUS_PRINT, uncounted.
